image_description: A close-up shot of a sliced meatloaf. The foreground features a slice with a glossy, yellowish-brown glaze that appears somewhat thick and uneven. The background shows the main loaf with a dark brown, textured interior crumb and a darker crust. The lighting is warm, highlighting the sheen on the glaze.
